Game Overview

Christmas Kenno Bot is a adventure title where embark on a festive quest in Christmas Kenno Bot. Glide through wintry landscapes as a plucky bot, evading enemy robots and dodging perilous traps. Master straightforward controls, execute nimble double-jumps, and tactically outsmart foes to gather all green gifts across escalating levels, reaching the ultimate goal.
